snippet.title: Cell to Singularity - FUTURE Expansion - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
What will the next 100 years hold for humanity?

Introducing the next major expansion to Cell to Singularity. From biotechnology to artificial intelligence, go further than ever before into a future rooted in scientific possibilities. Establish a lunar base and take the first steps on Mars in two brand new Primary Simulation gardens. Discover new mechanics, upgrades, Augments, and more in our biggest expansion yet.

The Future is here!

Music Credits
